workflow_group_contract.scope: Panel filter only: one primary group per record describing the current next-work/evidence disposition. Not a new work-order status, bug-confirmation, runtime health, root-resolution or authorization decision. workflow_status and five other axes remain authoritative within their stated evidence scope.
rules: Primary group is exclusive. Scope of historical subgroups must not be promoted to the entire record.
observing requires an actually started dated observation window and stated evidence; pending observation belongs to awaiting_verification/investigating, not observing.
scoped_verified only covers the original verified problem/range and does not claim root resolution for residual work.
not_replayable means documented historical inability to replay, never historical recovery.
mixed_historical_disposition preserves different statuses within one known incident; workflow_subgroups records exact subranges.
repair_pending does not imply missing user authorization; original pending-approval wording is only historical source text.
Empty enum groups are allowed; never manufacture an active observation or full-record irreversibility to fill a filter.
